anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Elena Murphy. From Ashford." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Hosny. The Static Kite, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Alba Nakamura. From Stonebridge." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 1,800 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
